zh-CN.A cut list diagram shows how every part: 先把项目尺寸、零件数量、材料类型和可见面要求写清楚。CutList 只有拿到真实约束，才能生成可以落地的板材排版。
zh-CN.Each rectangle is a part, usually labele: 输入实际板材尺寸、锯缝、纹理方向和是否允许旋转。对个人项目来说，提前把这些参数设准，比开锯后返工更省时间。
zh-CN.The big rectangles are your stock sheets: 生成方案后不要只看利用率，还要检查窄条、余料、切割顺序和容易混淆的重复零件。可视化布局是开工前的最后审核点。
zh-CN.The thin gaps between parts represent th: 把项目保存到历史记录，必要时导出 PDF 或打印切割清单。完成后对比实际余料，下次类似项目会规划得更准。
zh-CN.Arrows or markings often show grain dire: Arrows or markings often show grain direction, important for visible parts, and numbers may indicate cut order. Following the grain arrows keeps show faces oriented correctly; following the cut order keeps you from trapping a part or making a fragile cut early. These annotations turn a static map into a step-by-step plan.
zh-CN.Once you can read parts, sheets, kerf, g: Once you can read parts, sheets, kerf, grain, and order, the diagram becomes a confident plan: cut the first part as numbered, work through the sequence, and check each part against its label. The CutList app generates exactly this kind of diagram with kerf and grain, so a beginner can follow a clear, optimized plan to the finished parts.
确认所有零件名称和数量。

保存或导出最终切割方案。
